entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A strong demon who made a pact with Liliana Vess and guarded the Gate to the Afterlife on Amonkhet for Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who made a pact with four demons after the Mending.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker for whom Razaketh guarded the Gate to the Afterlife.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event after which Liliana dealt with four demons.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Plane where Razaketh guarded the Gate.

entities.name: Gate to the Afterlife
entities.description: Gate guarded by Razaketh that opened during the Final Hours.

entities.name: Second Sun
entities.description: Sun that came to rest between Bolas' Horn Monument during the Final Hours.

entities.name: Final Hours
entities.description: The time when the Gates opened and Razaketh was revealed.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City whose population saw Razaketh revealed.

entities.name: Luxa
entities.description: River that turned to blood at Razaketh's command.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers who intercepted Razaketh.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: God of Amonkhet killed by Razaketh in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: Razaketh's right hand in the Echoverse.

events.summary: The Gates of the Afterlife open and Razaketh is revealed to the people of Naktamun.
events.quote: the Gates of the Afterlife opened and Razaketh stood revealed before the population of Naktamun

events.summary: Razaketh turns the Luxa to blood and challenges Liliana.
events.quote: At the demon's command, the Luxa turned to blood, while he uttered a challenge to Liliana.

events.summary: Using a hidden clause in their contract, Razaketh takes control of Liliana's body.
events.quote: Razaketh managed to take control over Liliana's body

events.summary: The Gatewatch intercepts Razaketh, letting Liliana free herself; she tears him apart with her undead.
events.quote: she tore him apart and let her undead feast on his remains
